adminStep.title: Administration Account
adminStep.description: Get the initial token from the server log to create your new administration account.

header.title: Update to SCM-Manager 4
header.description: SCM-Manager has been updated to version 4. To complete the update, your intervention is needed.

updated.title: Plugin updates installed successfully
updated.description: Each installed plugin has been successfully updated with a SCM-Manager 4 compatible version. To finish the updating process, please restart your SCM-Manager server.

conflictingPlugins.title: Plugin updates failed
conflictingPlugins.description_one: There is one conflicting plugin. It is not compatible with the SCM-Manager since version 4. There is also no compatible update for it available. You can either try setting a different plugin center URL, uninstall this plugin or rollback to your previous version of the SCM-Manager.
conflictingPlugins.description_other: There are {{count}} conflicting plugins. They are not compatible with the SCM-Manager since version 4. There are also no compatible updates for them available. You can either try setting a different plugin center URL, uninstall those plugins or rollback to your previous version of the SCM-Manager.
conflictingPlugins.nonDefaultPluginCenterUrl: The currently configured plugin center URL differs from the default one. Unless using custom plugins, we would advice to use the default URL.

pluginCenterDeactivated.title: Deactivated Plugin Center
pluginCenterDeactivated.description_one: There is one conflicting plugin. It is not compatible with the SCM-Manager since version 4. The plugin center url is not set. Therefore it was not possible to search for a compatible update. Please set the plugin center url.
pluginCenterDeactivated.description_other: There are {{count}} conflicting plugins. They are not compatible with the SCM-Manager since version 4. The plugin center url is not set. Therefore it was not possible to search for compatible updates. Please set the plugin center url.

scm4CompatibilityStep.restartNotSupported: Your change was applied, but a server restart is required. Please restart your SCM-Manager server manually.

token.description: To continue on you need to authenticate yourself with a token. The token can be found within the logs of your SCM-Manager server.
token.label: Token
token.wrongToken: The token is invalid. Make sure you have copied the token correctly from the SCM-Manager logs.

pluginWizardStep.title: Plugin Sets
pluginWizardStep.description: Out of the box SCM-Manager is a streamlined tool to manage Git, SVN and mercurial repositories. Plugins enhance your workflow and help you to get more out of your SCM-Manager. Select one or more of our plugin-sets to jump-start your journey!

skip.title: Start without additional plugins
skip.subtitle: Only core-plugins will be installed. You may manually install plugins through the Plugin-Center any time.
